title: A member looks from a typed place, and home stays the default

criteria.text: The place control on Explore takes a typed town, county or market with suggestions; shows the home town by default
criteria.note: Not built. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V grep, git log since 11-20]: the place control is still `AreaPicker` (a metro list and a neighbourhood search), opened from the header search's Where; no typed town, county or market, no session vantage. #1484 adds a "Change area" link that opens the same picker [V PR body, `BrowseSurface.tsx`]. Open #698 (deferred).

criteria.text: Choosing a place sets the vantage for the session and is taken as the area type it is; the rings rebuild there
criteria.note: Not built: the pick is `?metro=`/`?area=`, a device cookie and, signed in, `member.default_metro.set` (saved as the member's default) [V]. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V grep, git log since 11-20]: the place control is still `AreaPicker` (a metro list and a neighbourhood search), opened from the header search's Where; no typed town, county or market, no session vantage. Open #698.

criteria.text: The vantage is session-only: never written to the member, never logged, never from GPS; a shared link reopens it
criteria.note: Not built: no vantage; a member's area pick is still saved as their default and the visitor's pick is remembered on the device (#1484 keeps that) [V `scope.ts`, `remembered-metro.ts`]. `?reach=` and the search travel in the link. No guard. Open #698.

criteria.text: The vantage is never derived from IP
criteria.note: Retired for a signed-out visitor: F081's ruling of 2026-11-25 ("A visitor's area is guessed from their IP and confirmed, or asked as a zip"; it replaces 2026-10-11 "No market is picked silently") is newer; #1484 builds to it with Vercel's city-level IP guess, read for the one answer and never stored, and never for a signed-in member [V PR body, `src/lib/geo/ip-location.ts`, `src/lib/metro/admission.ts`]. #1484 flags that the PM must retire the older record; `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: A vantage in a waiting market shows its cached waiting count and the tell-me control, and no Pages; another open market shows in full
criteria.note: Not built for a vantage: the waiting count and tell-me panel exist for a metro (F076, `MetroNotCoveredPanel`) and open from the picker; #1484 sends a visitor beyond an hour of every open market to "not open near you yet" with Choose your area, where a waiting market offers tell-me [V PR body]. No typed vantage reaches them. Open #699 (deferred).

criteria.text: A visitor with no location is prompted to enter a location or choose a market, with an arrow to the market selector; nothing is picked
criteria.note: Half built [V `admission.ts`, `scope.ts`, PR #1484]: with several markets open and no location, the visitor chooses; but with exactly one open (today, Sacramento) and no location (local dev, CI, a lookup miss) #1484 shows that market, as an interim "until the zip ask ships", which this criterion forbids; no arrow to the selector; the zip ask (F081 2026-11-25) is not built. #588 closed by #1484 on 2026-11-26. F059 criterion 6 still says the one open market is shown; F105's 2026-10-12 ruling is newer. Open #699.
